items.title: Summit Therapeutics Further Expands Ivonescimab Global Development Program with Phase II/III HARMONi-GU1 Study in 1L Bladder Cancer
items.summary: HARMONi-GU1 Is First Global Registrational Clinical Trial of Ivonescimab in a Genitourinary (GU) Cancer, Adding to Global Phase III Ivonescimab Studies in NSCLC and CRC Clinical Trial Site Activations Globally Planned to Begin by Q4 2026 Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today announced the expansion of its global registration-enabling clinical development program for the novel, potential first-in-class investigational bispecific antibody ivonescimab, into urothelial carcinoma, or bladder cancer, with the initiation of the global, multi-regional Phase II/III HARMONi-GU1 trial. Summit is starting a randomized Phase II/III clinical study, HARMONi-GU1, to evaluate ivonescimab plus the antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) enfortumab vedotin (EV) compared to pembrolizumab plus EV as first-line therapy in patients with previously untreated locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.
